text:
sara: quick heads-up — brought up tempest-v1 q4f (int8) on staging and ran the locale-focused eval suite. seeing a cluster of detok/ligature issues around zero-width chars and narrow NBSP in ja/ar.

sara: short metrics snapshot:
```
ja BLEU: 21.8 (-3.5 vs fp32)
zh BLEU: 29.2 (-0.4)
ar BLEU: 16.9 (-4.8 vs fp32)
```

liam: is this repo-specific to tempest or trending across other q4f artifacts?

sara: I sampled two other q4f builds (cassio and orion-lite) — similar but smaller deltas. tempest shows worst-case.

rachel: any common token patterns in failures?

sara: yes — most failing samples include one of: ZWJ (U+200D), ZWNJ (U+200C), hair space (U+200A), or narrow no-break space (U+202F) adjacent to punctuation or inside ligature sequences.

sara: example:
Input (JP): "お待ちください‍。" -> Output int8: "お待ちください 。" (ZWJ dropped, extra space)
Input (AR): "(مثال )" -> Output int8: ")مثال(" or loses proper RTL mirroring

tom: did we change tokenizer normalizations in onboarding? any folding of whitespace variants?

sara: tokenizer v3 added a folding rule for narrow NBSP->NBSP in some locales last week. local bisect shows:
- fp32 + tok v3 => baseline OK
- int8 q4f + tok v2 => small regressions
- int8 q4f + tok v3 => biggest regressions
so looks like tokenizer normalization + quant remap/packing interaction.

liam: @eval-bot can you queue a compare run: tempest-v1 fp32 vs q4f on a focused set (zwj/zwnj/nnbsp) and produce token-diff counts?

eval-bot: compare job queued: compare-tempest-1769302468. Link: https://ci.redwood/tempest/compare/1769302468

rachel: short triage plan: 1) run q4f with remap_passthrough=true to disable folding, 2) run int8 with kernel=fp32-emulate to isolate numeric vs remap, 3) disable prefix cache to rule out KV index skew.

sara: running remap_passthrough and fp32-emulate now, will post traces.

liam: if remap_passthrough fixes it, we should pin tok v2 for q4f canary and add an eval gate detecting ZWJ/ZWNJ disappearance near punctuation.

rachel: i'll add a small synthetic harness test that injects ZWJ/ZWNJ inside ligatures and fails canary if token-substitution rate > 1% or BLEU delta on mini-suite > 2.5.

eval-bot: compare finished: tempest-v1 q4f vs fp32 summary: JA -3.4, AR -4.7, flagged 58/72 ZWJ/ZWNJ/NBSP anomalies. results: https://ci.redwood/tempest/compare/1769302468/results

sara: remap_passthrough run reduces anomalies to near baseline (JA delta -0.6). fp32-emulate helps a bit but remap_passthrough biggest win. looks like folding/remap inconsistency.

tom: devs should audit the remap serialization and the compact packing introduced for q4f. likely mis-applied remap on decode path or cache layer.

sara: action items:
- sara: upload 12 minimal repros + token-id traces (s3 link in follow-up)
- tom: audit remap folding and KVC packing (ETA EOD)
- rachel: add ZWJ/ZWNJ synthetic test to harness and gate (ETA EOD)
- liam: prepare a staging rollback plan / remap_passthrough flip if needed

liam: thanks — keep updates here. :thumbsup:
